title: Mock Interview
scenario: A reviewer asks you to explain your work as if you were interviewing for a junior security role in an AI-enabled enterprise.
objective: Explain a finding, its risk, the verification method, responsible AI use, and how you would communicate uncertainty.
ai_native_dimension: The learner must explain when AI helped, when it failed, and why human accountability remained necessary.
deliverables: interview_answers.md answers all five prompts with evidence-backed examples
aar_questions: What was the security problem in Mock Interview and what objective evidence proved it?
What was the risk if it remained unresolved?
What did you change and why?
How did you verify the result independently of AI output?
Where did AI help, where was it wrong/incomplete, and what remained your responsibility?
